planning_notes: The request for 5 MEDIUM difficulty targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool and assigning each a unique pedagogical facet to ensure non-redundancy. The selection covers the theoretical foundation (VAE Concept, KL Divergence), the core mechanism (Reparameterization Trick), the practical implementation (Encoder Architecture), and the application context (Fashion-MNIST). This distribution ensures a balanced assessment of conceptual understanding, theoretical rationale, code interpretation, and practical application.
